feature: Identity interstitial (Git #1296): a non-CustomerUser role (PlatformAdmin, MSPAdmin, MSPOperator, ServiceAccount) logging in through the customer-facing /portal/ login now lands on a new identity interstitial instead of straight to /dashboard. It offers two choices -- log out and go sign in at /admin-panel/, or accept and continue into /portal-v2 with tenant impersonation available. CustomerUser is unaffected and still lands straight on /portal-v2. TenantSwitcherFloaty and ImpersonationBanner are now also mounted on PortalV2Shell.tsx (previously only on the legacy app-shell.tsx).
notes: ENV VARS required: DEPLOY_URL, TEST_ADMIN_EMAIL/TEST_ADMIN_PASSWORD (PlatformAdmin -- the non-CustomerUser account driving the primary assertions), TEST_CUSTOMER_EMAIL/TEST_CUSTOMER_PASSWORD (CustomerUser -- the negative control proving the interstitial does not appear for that role).

Mirrors test-manifests/portal/customer-home-landing.json's landing-proof pattern: no explicit goto after login-submit, so the DOM assertion can only pass if the real post-login redirect (login.tsx resolvedLanding) sent the account there.
